payload.title: Integrate durable events, ownership and due decisions into existing operator
payload.goal: Extend the current operator into a fenced mission adapter with zero idle inference.
payload.owner_role: Designated Windows release parent assigns one admitted implementation owner; separate exact-source reviewer; existing scheduled operator retains integration/effect ownership
implementation_steps: Bind existing hourly/growth/lead triggers to one authoritative mission claim and action ledger; map existing state IDs without deleting runs or resetting business clock.
Add event types request_received, scan_completed, scope_accepted, delivery_due, source_changed, metric_window_due, cash_settled and owner_direction_changed with dedup key/evidence revision.
Persist next_check_at, decision fingerprint, owner fence and checkpoint atomically; dispatch only eligible declared action types into existing route.
Keep existing Actions concurrency as local serialization; reject expired/stale host tokens and require reconciliation before Windows executor takeover.
Use deterministic observation collectors; unchanged or not-due evidence returns without a model invocation, with per-event retries and finite queue capacity.

Schedule mission_horizon_due from the preserved config/business.json deadline_at_utc 2026-11-22T04:59:59Z (November 21 local close), not a reset 90-day timer. Produce one durable decision event at the boundary.
tests: 100 unchanged timer checks produce zero model calls and zero duplicated jobs.
Simultaneous Actions/Windows claims yield one accepted owner; stale token cannot deliver response or release content.
Duplicate event and crash at checkpoint boundary retain one job and monotonic event cursor.
Cross deadline with unchanged traffic: exactly one horizon event becomes due and no duplicate model decision appears on repeated polls; original start/deadline remain unchanged.

review.identity_requirement: Reviewer-authored record with actual reviewer identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model qualification is required for runtime/release acceptance and is not supplied by this plan.
review.exact_source: Bind immutable implementation commit, task/spec hash, artifact hashes, executed test receipts and any destination receipt. New source invalidates prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two targeted repair/review cycles; unresolved findings become a linked blocked task, preserving attempts.

acceptance: Existing operator remains the single mission effect owner or has a recorded fenced handoff.
Changed evidence/due work executes without a manual launch prompt while idle ticks stay deterministic.
Original mission clock is preserved and its end triggers one reviewed horizon decision; post-horizon effects require valid extension authority.
payload.rollback: Disable new adapter dispatch and return to prior qualified owner only after uncertain-effect reconciliation; preserve migrated records and cursor.
payload.next_eligible_action: Implement adapter against shared contract fixtures; keep it disconnected from existing production triggers until admission.

estimate.assumptions: New planning range for admitted implementation and bounded review; reuses evidenced assets; excludes observation waiting, non-delegable account work and shared-platform implementation. Not a replacement for historical Jira estimates or measured actuals.
estimate.dependency_risk: Depends on shared transactional claims and Windows capability; no migration required for useful release.
